name: ur cutter prowess

winrate_basis.why: no head-to-head winrate exists for Modern in any source this repo can reach: statistics_matchups returns zero rows for the format, statistics_archetypes carries no winrate field, and this run's own fingerprint records winrate_vs_field as all-zero. Recording a number here would be inventing one.

opponent_gameplan: One-mana threats plus Cori-Steel Cutter tokens and free pump, killing on turn three or four; post-board they add graveyard hate and Consign to Memory for the cascade trigger.

opponent_plan.posture_why: One-mana threats and Cori-Steel Cutter tokens kill on turn three or four; the post-board Consign to Memory and Tormod's Crypt exist only to keep our sweeper-and-cascade reset off the table.

key_cards.why: makes a token every turn with free pump behind it, which is how the clock rebuilds after a sweeper
one mana with replicate for the cascade trigger, so the reset never resolves and the race stands
free instant-speed graveyard exile that empties the payload in response, buying the turns their clock needs

primary_gameplan: Anger resets the board for a deck that has already spent its hand, and Dispute protects the one cascade we need to resolve.
pitfalls: Sweeping into open mana with Mutagenic Growth up and no follow-up - they rebuild with one Cutter trigger.
Cycling aggressively into Lava Dart flashback range while at fifteen or less.
Holding Dispute for Consign to Memory when the real counter is Spell Snare on Shardless Agent.
stance_rationale: They win with two toughness and a Cutter, and lose to us only by countering the cascade trigger, so a sweeper plus counters for their blue interaction covers both halves.

opposing_sideboard_in.why: one mana with replicate, countering the cascade trigger itself rather than the spell
free, instant-speed, and empties the payload in response to the cascade
takes all three Living End for free once one is in the graveyard
one-mana permanent graveyard hate that also strips a single card on entry

play_plan.keep: Two red sources plus a cycler, or a hand that Angers on three; one-landers are unplayable here.
play_plan.goldfish_for: Anger into an untapped land for Dispute, so the follow-up cascade resolves.
play_plan.watch_for: One untapped Island and no attack means Consign to Memory, not Spell Snare - bait with Shardless Agent.
play_plan.posture_why: the sweeper resets a deck that cannot rebuild fast.
